<html lang="en"><head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <meta name="description" content="Mohamed Shehata — Head of UX, UX & Product Design Leader with 23+ years building world-class digital products across the GCC.">
  <title>Mohamed Shehata</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="./favicon.svg">
  <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="./favicon.svg">

  <link rel="preload" href="./assets/hero-orange.jpg" as="image">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Dancing+Script:wght@600;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,700;0,900;1,700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/Flip.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/splitting/dist/splitting.min.js"></script>


  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       VARIABLES
    ============================================================ */
    :root {
      --off-white: #f0efeb;
      --black:     #111111;
      --accent:    #e84020;
      --white:     #ffffff;
      --mid:       #888888;
      --border-light: rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      --border-dark:  rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      --font: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
      --mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       RESET + BASE
    ============================================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    /* ============================================================
       CUSTOM CIRCLE CURSOR (pointer devices only)
    ============================================================ */
    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      html, body { cursor: none; }
      a, button, [data-cursor-hover] { cursor: none; }
    }
    .custom-cursor {
      --cx: 0px;
      --cy: 0px;
      --cs: 1;
      position: fixed;
      left: 0; top: 0;
      width: 24px; height: 24px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(232, 64, 32, 0.7);
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translate(calc(var(--cx) - 50%), calc(var(--cy) - 50%)) scale(var(--cs));
      z-index: 9999;
      transition:
        --cs 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),
        background-color 0.18s ease-out,
        border-color 0.18s ease-out,
        box-shadow 0.18s ease-out,
        opacity 0.2s ease-out;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    .custom-cursor.is-ready { opacity: 1; }
    .custom-cursor--active {
      --cs: 1.8;
      background-color: rgba(232, 64, 32, 0.18);
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(232, 64, 32, 0.9);
    }
    @media (hover: none), (pointer: coarse) {
      .custom-cursor { display: none; }
    }
    body {
      font-family: var(--font);
      background: var(--off-white);
      color: var(--black);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    img, video { display: block; max-width: 100%; }

    /* ============================================================
       SECTION LABEL  →  // Label
    ============================================================ */
    .sec-label {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    .sec-label::before { content: '// '; }

    /* ============================================================
       REVEAL ANIMATION
    ============================================================ */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(28px);
      transition: opacity 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .reveal.d1 { transition-delay: 80ms; }
    .reveal.d2 { transition-delay: 160ms; }
    .reveal.d3 { transition-delay: 240ms; }
    .reveal.d4 { transition-delay: 320ms; }
    .reveal.d5 { transition-delay: 400ms; }

    /* ============================================================
       NAV — modern floating pill, anchors to sections
    ============================================================ */
    #nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 22px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 100;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 6px 6px 6px 18px;
      background: rgba(17,17,17,0.55);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
      border-radius: 999px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
      transition:
        opacity 0.3s ease,
        transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);
    }
    #nav.is-hidden {
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-16px);
    }
    .nav-logo {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      padding-right: 14px;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      line-height: 1;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .nav-logo .nav-dot { color: var(--accent); }
    .nav-pill {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .nav-pill li { padding: 0; margin: 0; list-style: none; }
    .nav-pill a {
      position: relative;
      display: block;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      letter-spacing: 0.01em;
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: color 0.25s;
      white-space: nowrap;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .nav-pill a:hover { color: #fff; }
    .nav-pill a.is-active { color: #fff; }
    .nav-indicator {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      height: 100%;
      width: 0;
      background: rgba(232,64,32,0.92);
      border-radius: 999px;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 1;
      opacity: 0;
      transition:
        left 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),
        width 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),
        opacity 0.25s ease,
        background 0.25s ease;
    }
    .nav-indicator.is-ready { opacity: 1; }
    .nav-cta {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--accent);
      transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.25s;
      white-space: nowrap;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .nav-cta:hover { background: #ff5734; transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* ============================================================
       HERO
    ============================================================ */
    /* ============================================================
       SPLASH SCREEN
    ============================================================ */
    #splash {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 9999;
      background: #111111;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0;
      pointer-events: all;
    }
    .splash-inner {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .splash-label {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .splash-label::before { content: '// '; }
    .splash-name {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: clamp(36px, 9vw, 80px);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .splash-name span { color: var(--accent); }
    .splash-track {
      width: min(260px, 60vw);
      height: 2px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
      border-radius: 2px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .splash-bar {
      height: 100%;
      width: 0%;
      background: var(--accent);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: width 0.4s ease;
    }

    #hero {
      min-height: 100dvh;
      background: var(--off-white);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    /* Full-bleed base photo (orange/warm) */
    .hero-photo-wrap {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    .hero-photo-wrap img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
    }
    /* Bottom vignette so name text stays legible */
    .hero-photo-wrap::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        to top,
        rgba(17,17,17,0.72) 0%,
        rgba(17,17,17,0.18) 40%,
        transparent 70%
      );
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ── WebGL fluid canvas (Three-skull fluid sim) ── */
    #hero-gl {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 1;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Social links — vertically centred on the left edge */
    .hero-social {
      position: absolute;
      left: 40px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      z-index: 3;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .hero-social a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .hero-social a:hover { color: #fff; }

    /* Title — inline flow, sits directly above the name */
    .hero-title {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 3;
      text-align: right;
      padding: 0 48px 18px 40px;
    }
    .hero-title-text {
      font-size: clamp(14px, 1.4vw, 20px);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.3;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .hero-title-slash {
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-right: 6px;
    }

    /* Oversized name — bottom, bleeds right */
    .hero-name-wrap {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      padding-bottom: 0;
      overflow: visible;
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .hero-name {
      font-size: 240px; /* fallback — JS computes the exact size to fit width */
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 0.85;
      color: #fff;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding-left: 32px;
      padding-right: 32px;
      animation: heroNameIn 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 0.1s both;
    }

    @keyframes heroNameIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(40px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }
    @keyframes heroFadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to   { opacity: 1; }
    }

    /* Social uses its own fade that keeps the transform intact */
    @keyframes heroSocialIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(calc(-50% + 12px)); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    }
    .hero-social { animation: heroSocialIn 1s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 0.7s both; }
    .hero-title  { animation: heroFadeIn 1s ease 0.9s both; }


    .scroll-hint {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 28px;
      left: 50%;
      z-index: 3;
      animation: scrollBob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite 2s;
    }
    @keyframes scrollBob {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
      50%       { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px); opacity: 1; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       INTRO — dark section with large statement
    ============================================================ */
    #intro {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 120px 40px;
    }
    .intro-inner {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .intro-statement {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.25;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: #fff;
      perspective: 900px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    /* Manual line wrappers — clip the 3D flip */
    .ist-line {
      display: block;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding-bottom: 0.06em;
    }
    .ist-inner {
      display: block;
    }
    .intro-statement .accent-phrase {
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .intro-right {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 28px;
      padding-top: 8px;
    }
    .intro-body {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      line-height: 1.8;
      max-width: 44ch;
    }
    .intro-cta {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 12px 32px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      border-radius: 100px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      width: fit-content;
      transition: all 0.25s;
    }
    .intro-cta:hover {
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      color: #fff;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* Stats row inside intro */
    .intro-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 40px;
      padding-top: 32px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .intro-stat-num {
      font-size: 36px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .intro-stat-num.red { color: var(--accent); }
    .intro-stat-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      font-weight: 500;
      margin-top: 4px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .stat-pipe { width: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); flex-shrink: 0; }

    /* ============================================================
       NUMBERED SECTIONS  (About, Expertise)
    ============================================================ */
    .numbered-section {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 80px 40px 100px;
    }
    .numbered-section.light {
      background: var(--off-white);
    }

    .ns-header {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto 64px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-dark);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .ns-header {
      border-top-color: var(--border-light);
    }

    .ns-ghost-num {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: clamp(80px, 14vw, 180px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      line-height: 0.85;
      color: transparent;
      -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      user-select: none;
      pointer-events: none;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .ns-ghost-num {
      -webkit-text-stroke: 1.5px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .ns-title-block {
      flex: 1;
      padding-left: 48px;
    }
    .ns-h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 4vw, 52px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: #fff;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .ns-h2 { color: var(--black); }

    .ns-desc {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      line-height: 1.75;
      max-width: 50ch;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .ns-desc { color: #777; }

    /* Horizontal list items */
    .h-list {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }
    .h-list-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 18px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      gap: 24px;
      cursor: default;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .h-list-item {
      border-bottom-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .h-list-item:first-child { border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .numbered-section.light .h-list-item:first-child { border-top-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

    .h-item-name {
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 22px);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .h-item-name { color: var(--black); }

    .h-item-num {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .numbered-section.light .h-item-num { color: rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }

    /* ============================================================
       EXPERTISE — 100vh fit, 2 columns, orange cylinders behind
    ============================================================ */
    .numbered-section.exp-fit {
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 56px 40px 0;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .exp-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .exp-content .ns-header { margin-bottom: 28px; width: 100%; }
    .exp-content .ns-h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 44px); }
    .exp-content .ns-desc { font-size: 14px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .exp-content .exp-title-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 40px;
      align-items: end;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    /* Two-column item grid */
    .h-list-2col {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      column-gap: 56px;
      row-gap: 0;
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      align-content: start;
    }
    .h-list-2col .h-list-item {
      padding: 13px 0;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-bottom: none;
    }
    .h-list-2col .h-list-item:nth-last-child(-n+2) {
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    }
    .h-list-2col .h-item-name { font-size: clamp(14px, 1.3vw, 17px); }

    /* WebGL canvas backdrop for cylinders grid */
    #exp-cyl-canvas {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       ABOUT — split layout on light bg
    ============================================================ */
    #about { background: var(--off-white); padding: 100px 40px; }
    .about-wrap { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .about-header {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 64px;
    }
    .about-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 80px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    .about-photo {
      position: relative;
    }
    .about-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      aspect-ratio: 3/4;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center top;
      filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(1.06);
    }
    /* Floating tag on photo */
    .about-photo-tag {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -1px;
      left: -1px;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 8px 16px;
    }

    .about-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
    .about-h2 {
      font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 48px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .about-body {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #666;
      line-height: 1.82;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .about-body strong { color: var(--black); font-weight: 600; }

    .cert-block {
      margin-top: 32px;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .cert-block:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .cert-bar { width: 3px; height: 52px; background: var(--accent); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .cert-name {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--black);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .cert-sub {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #999;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .live-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #aaa;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .live-dot {
      width: 7px; height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #22c55e;
      animation: livePulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes livePulse {
      0%,100% { opacity:1; transform:scale(1); }
      50% { opacity:0.4; transform:scale(0.8); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       EXPERIENCE — dark numbered section
    ============================================================ */
    #experience {
      background: var(--black);
      padding: 100px 40px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       VIBE CODING — dark, videos
    ============================================================ */
    /* SVG Mask Scroll Transition (Tympanus / Hiro-kiii) */
    #vibe-coding {
      position: relative;
      height: 600vh;
      background: #0a0a0a;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .vc-pin {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .vc-layer {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
    }
    .vc-layer image {
      filter: brightness(0.6) contrast(1.08);
    }

    /* Section header overlay */
    .vc-overlay-header {
      position: absolute;
      top: 32px;
      left: 40px;
      z-index: 10;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    }
    .vc-overlay-counter {
      position: absolute;
      top: 32px;
      right: 40px;
      z-index: 10;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Text panels — one per project, layered */
    .vc-txts {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .vc-txt {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      padding: 12vh 8vw 14vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-end;

      transform: translateY(40px);
      will-change: clip-path, transform;

    .vc-txt-brand {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .vc-txt-title {
      font-family: var(--font);
      font-size: clamp(48px, 8vw, 132px);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
      line-height: 0.92;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      max-width: 14ch;
    }
    .vc-txt-desc {
      font-size: clamp(14px, 1.05vw, 17px);
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);
      max-width: 52ch;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }
    .vc-txt-meta {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .vc-txt-chip {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);

    .vc-txt-chip.accent { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); color: #fff; }
    .vc-txt-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 120, 30, 0.6);
      background: rgba(255, 90, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;

    .vc-txt-link:hover {

    /* Progress bar — 5 segments at bottom */
    .vc-progress {

      gap: 10px;

    /* ── HeroFrame cinematic block ── */
    .hf-block {
      background: #0d0d0d;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);

      width: 40px;

    .hf-tagline {
      font-size: clamp(32px, 4.5vw, 56px);

    .hf-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
      line-height: 1.75;
      max-width: 48ch;
      margin-bottom: 20px;

    .hf-chips {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hf-chip {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;

      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);

    }
    .hf-pricing {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;

    }

      font-weight: 700;

    .hf-tier-pro { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }
    .hf-tier-pro span { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-weight: 400; margin-left: 4px; }

      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15) !important;

    .hf-cta:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7) !important; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3) !important; }

    /* Poster fan */
    .hf-poster-fan {
      position: relative;
      height: 320px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .hf-poster {
      position: absolute;
      height: 100%;
      width: auto;
      object-fit: cover;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.5s;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }
    .hf-poster-fan .hf-poster:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-9deg) translate(-60px, 12px);  z-index: 1; }
    .hf-poster-fan .hf-poster:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(-3deg) translate(20px,  6px);   z-index: 2; }
    .hf-poster-fan .hf-poster:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(3deg)  translate(100px, -2px);  z-index: 3; }
    .hf-poster-fan .hf-poster:nth-child(4) { transform: rotate(9deg)  translate(180px, -12px); z-index: 4; }
    .hf-poster-fan:hover .hf-poster:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-18deg) translate(-120px, 20px); }
    .hf-poster-fan:hover .hf-poster:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(-6deg)  translate(0px,    8px);  }
    .hf-poster-fan:hover .hf-poster:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(6deg)   translate(120px, -8px);  }
    .hf-poster-fan:hover .hf-poster:nth-child(4) { transform: rotate(18deg)  translate(240px, -20px); }
    .hf-poster-fan:hover .hf-poster { box-shadow: 0 32px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.85); }

      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: 0;

      gap: 0;
      width: max-content;
      animation: hfMarquee 28s linear infinite;
    }
    .hf-marquee:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }
    @keyframes hfMarquee {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }
    .hf-sport-tile {
      position: relative;
      width: 130px;
      height: 80px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);

      height: 100%;

      transition: opacity 0.3s;
      display: block;

      position: absolute;
      bottom: 6px;
      left: 0; right: 0;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;

      text-transform: uppercase;

          return fract(p.x * p.y);
        }
        float noise(vec2 p){

          vec2 f = fract(p);

            mix(hash(i),           hash(i+vec2(1.0,0.0)), f.x),
